results.statement: [tool.sc-lint].setup.pre must accept an argv list that the sc-lint setup command (just setup) runs before it provisions sc-lint.
results.quote:
`setup.pre` (argv run by `just setup` before sc-lint provisioning)
[…]
[tool.sc-lint.setup]
pre = ["just", "bootstrap"]
[…]
**(c) Commitment:** yes, we commit to this split now and will adopt in the first release that ships it
